subchapters.title: Rutherford model
subchapters.theory: Rutherford model is studied using physical laws, definitions and idealised models appropriate to this topic. Identify the relevant variables, sign convention and assumptions before applying an equation. For NEET problems, distinguish scalar and vector quantities, keep SI units consistent, and check limiting cases. The key result should be interpreted physically rather than used as a memorised expression.

examples.solution: Start by defining Rutherford model. Write the governing relation, substitute the given quantities in SI units, simplify, and check the dimensions. This method avoids using an unrelated formula.

mcqs.q: Which statement is most appropriate for Rutherford model?
options: The governing relation must be applied with consistent SI units.
Units can be ignored because equations are unit-independent.
A scalar can always replace a vector without changing the result.
Dimensional consistency guarantees every equation is physically correct.
mcqs.explanation: For Rutherford model, the first statement is the correct general principle. SI consistency and the assumptions of the model are essential.
